name: Garrison Border Town of Elvas and its Fortifications
description: Elvas is a hilltop frontier town in eastern Portugal, just 8 km from the Spanish city of Badajoz. After Portugal regained independence in 1640, it was ringed with vast star-shaped bastions and deep dry ditches, the largest system of its kind in the world. Visitors can walk the ramparts, see old barracks and churches, and look up at the long arches of the Amoreira aqueduct, built to keep the town supplied during sieges.
